# WM Zero CDN Asset Localizer

> WordPress plugin that checks the site's front page for Google Fonts, Font Awesome, cdnjs, jsDelivr and unpkg references and downloads a Google Fonts stylesheet with its WOFF2 files into `wp-content/uploads/wm-zero-cdn/`. It does not replace the remote link automatically; the theme has to load the local copy.

## Overview

`wm-zero-cdn-asset-localizer` is a WordPress plugin developed with an agentic workflow (AI coding agents). It offers an admin screen with measured figures, REST routes and WP-CLI commands for administrators (`wp cdn scan`, `wp cdn localize`), optional preload links, and registers as a spoke of the WM Suite Hub. It makes no legal assessment; an unreadable front page is reported as unreadable, never as clean.

## Standards & Compliance

- Version 1.2.1.
- PHP 8.2+ / Strict Types / PSR-12 / WPCS
- Zero-CDN Invariant (the plugin's own assets are self-hosted)
- wp_safe_remote_get() with status and WOFF2 signature checks / manage_options on REST / textContent in admin JS
- DSGVO/GDPR: no personal data stored
